name: 卡瓦重
evolution: 丢丢 → 卡卡虫 Lv.16 → 卡瓦重 Lv.36
description: 手里拿的是生长着果实的枝条，既是武器也是乐器，需要时还能解解嘴馋。战斗像舞蹈一样，用细长灵活的舌头和尾巴表演，让人眼花缭乱。
descriptionEn: What it holds is a branch with fruit growing on it, which serves as both weapon and instrument, and can also satisfy a craving when needed. Its fighting is like a dance, performed with its slender, flexible tongue and tail, dazzling the eye.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 筛管奔流
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己生命大于80%时，本次技能威力+75。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when the user's HP is above 80%, this skill's power +75.

skills.name: 顶端优势
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 棘刺
skills.descriptionEn: The opponent gains 1 stack of Thorn mark.

skills.name: 天旋地转
skills.description: 造成物理伤害，先手+1，迸发：本次技能威力+30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, priority +1; burst: this skill's power +30.

skills.name: 富养化
skills.description: 为场下每个精灵回复3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores 3 energy to each spirit off the field.

skills.name: 藤绞
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复5能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the user restores 5 energy.

skills.name: 主场优势
skills.descriptionEn: The user gains 1 stack of Attack mark.

skills.name: 孢子爆散
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，每次使用后，本技能连击数永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit; after each use, this skill's hit count is permanently +2.

skills.name: 丰饶
skills.descriptionEn: The user gains Attack and Magic Attack +140%.

skills.name: 抽枝
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：自己回复50%生命和5能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering: the user restores 50% HP and 5 energy.

skills.name: 盛开
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+30，应对防御：改为威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: The user gains all skills power +30; when countering a defense: instead power +60.
